results.title: ET 40 Under Forty: India's brightest young business leaders
results.content: **Career turning point:** The day I realised that I cannot be an armchair critic, and if I am passionate about the education sector, then I need to do something to make a difference. **Success to me:** Inspiring the next generation to invest in purpose-oriented businesses; seeing and feeling the impact that we create in rural India and the lives of our rural women entrepreneurs first hand - when they are able to make economic decisions on their own. **Career turning point:** When I started working on long-term transformation with leading entrepreneurs/ CEOs, being able to make a real difference to organisations helped me rediscover my own energy for consulting. **The best advice I ever got:** *The best way to broaden your impact is by focusing your energy on helping people around you be more successful.*. **Career turning point:** When I got private equity partners TPG and QRG onboard in 2017, I was able to position the company as an attractive and investable proposition by creating a compelling vision, effective leadership and strategic decision-making.
